title.en: Siri launches on iPhone 4S — millions of ordinary people meet AI for the first time
title.zhHans: Siri 在 iPhone 4S 上亮相——亿万普通人第一次遇见 AI

summary.en: On October 4, 2011, Apple unveiled the iPhone 4S with Siri, the first widely available conversational AI assistant embedded in a mass-market device. For millions of people, Siri was their first direct interaction with artificial intelligence — asking about the weather, setting alarms, or getting answers by voice. Siri transformed AI from a lab concept into a daily reality, paving the way for every voice assistant that followed.
summary.zhHans: 2011 年 10 月 4 日，苹果发布了内置 Siri 的 iPhone 4S，这是首个嵌入大众市场设备的广泛可用对话式 AI 助手。对数百万人来说，Siri 是他们与人工智能的第一次直接互动——通过语音询问天气、设置闹钟或获取答案。Siri 将 AI 从实验室概念变成了日常现实，为所有后来的语音助手铺平了道路。

narrative.en: Siri began life as a standalone app spun out of SRI International's CALO project (a DARPA-funded AI initiative). Apple acquired it in April 2010, then integrated it deeply into the iPhone 4S. At the launch event, Apple executives demoed Siri checking the weather, sending texts, and finding restaurants — simple tasks, but delivered through natural conversation rather than menus and buttons. The cultural reception was immense. Late-night hosts joked about Siri, people shared screenshots of funny Siri conversations, and a new phrase — 'ask Siri' — entered everyday language. Siri had limitations: it failed at complex queries, required internet connectivity, and was easily confused by accents. But it didn't matter. Siri proved that millions of people were ready to talk to machines. It validated the entire conversational AI paradigm that would later culminate in ChatGPT, Alexa, and Google Assistant. Siri was also controversial: its voice recognition collected data back to Apple, raising early privacy questions about always-listening AI. The assistant remained a staple of Apple's ecosystem — evolving over the years with deep learning, becoming more capable but also sparking competition from Amazon's Alexa (2014) and Google Assistant (2016).
narrative.zhHans: Siri 最初是一个独立应用，源自 SRI International 的 CALO 项目（DARPA 资助的 AI 计划）。苹果于 2010 年 4 月将其收购，然后深度集成到 iPhone 4S 中。在发布会上，苹果高管演示了 Siri 查询天气、发送短信和查找餐厅——简单的任务，但通过自然对话而非菜单和按钮完成。文化反响巨大。深夜秀主持人拿 Siri 开玩笑，人们分享有趣的 Siri 对话截图，"问 Siri" 成为日常语言中的新短语。Siri 有局限：复杂查询经常失败，需要网络连接，容易混淆口音。但这并不重要。Siri 证明了数百万人已经准备好与机器对话。它验证了整个对话式 AI 范式，后来在 ChatGPT、Alexa 和 Google Assistant 中达到顶峰。Siri 也有争议：其语音识别将数据传回苹果，引发了关于始终监听 AI 的早期隐私问题。该助手一直是苹果生态系统的核心——多年来随着深度学习的发展不断进化，能力增强，但也引发了来自亚马逊 Alexa（2014 年）和 Google Assistant（2016 年）的竞争。

description.en: First mainstream conversational AI. Put AI in the pockets of millions. Validated voice as a human-AI interface. Created the consumer AI assistant category.
description.zhHans: 首个主流对话式 AI。将 AI 放进了亿万人的口袋。验证了语音作为人机交互界面。创建了消费级 AI 助手品类。

text.en: Apple launched Siri on the iPhone 4S on October 4, 2011. It was the first widely available virtual assistant on a major smartphone platform.
text.zhHans: 苹果于 2011 年 10 月 4 日在 iPhone 4S 上推出了 Siri。这是首个在主流智能手机平台上广泛可用的虚拟助手。

sources.quote: October 4, 2011: With the unveiling of the iPhone 4s, Apple introduces the world to Siri.
Siri was introduced on iPhone 4S in October 2011.

changeLog.summary: Added Siri — first mainstream conversational AI assistant.
